data.title: Vivy · 雨中的伞与流浪狗
data.description: 游乐园闭园后的雨，她蹲在屋檐下为一只湿淋淋的流浪狗撑伞，裙摆浸在水里也不管；轻声哼着歌安抚它，伞全倾向了狗那边。
data.action: 游乐园闭园后的雨，她蹲在屋檐下为一只湿淋淋的流浪狗撑伞，裙摆浸在水里也不管
data.promptProse: After the amusement park closes in the rain, Vivy crouches beneath the eaves and tips her umbrella almost entirely over a soaked stray dog. Her blue waterproof coat covers the stage outfit and opaque tights, the lower hem near the puddle as she hums softly. The medium view includes the doorway and empty wet walkway. Doorway light illuminates the dog's fur and her blue hair, with bright water reflections just beyond the sheltered shadow.
